stories.headline: Israeli strike on MSF clinic in Gaza kills two staff

stories.headline: Zelensky says US is not pressing Russia hard enough in peace talks
stories.teaser: Ukraine's president criticised the Trump-Putin friendship as 'strange' and voiced frustration with Washington. A market puts a 6% chance on a signed peace deal by the end of 2026.

market.question: Ukraine signs peace deal with Russia by December 31, 2026?

stories.headline: Israeli opposition races to oust Netanyahu as Iran ceasefire stays tense
stories.teaser: Former military chief Gadi Eisenkot has given himself until Dec. 6 to form a new Israeli government. Meanwhile, Iranian drone strikes on Gulf states are adding pressure in the region.

market.question: Israel x Iran ceasefire ends before Netanyahu out?

stories.headline: Europe readies post-war Ukraine force as Russia warns of targeting troops
stories.teaser: A European-led force has trained for a deployment to Ukraine after a ceasefire, not for combat. Moscow says any foreign troops would be legitimate targets.
